observations: VerifyStoreEvidence, VerifySealedManifest, and VerifySealedFile in internal/evidence/verify.go perform strict read-only streaming verification of sealed evidence blobs and manifests without modifying source bytes.

One-byte modification (digest_mismatch / ErrDigestMismatch), size mismatch (size_mismatch / ErrSizeMismatch), and missing evidence/manifest files (missing_file / ErrEvidenceMissing) return mutually distinct typed failure codes and sentinel errors.
Ed25519 AuthorityAttestation verification rejects untrusted keys, spoofed key IDs, forged signatures, and omitted required authority with ErrAuthorityUntrusted (untrusted_signer).

AuthorityTracker rejects expired attestations (ErrAuthorityExpired) and stale/replayed revisions (ErrAuthorityStaleRevision) while preserving the last valid accepted authority revision across failed checks and SealStore restarts.

observed_limitations: Append-only custody event chaining belongs to C11 (internal/custody/events.go).
